WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    MIN(ORDERED_AT) AS first_order_date
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
acquisition_cohorts AS (
  SELECT
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', first_order_date) AS acquisition_month
  FROM first_orders
),
customer_lifetime_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    ac.acquisition_month,
    ac.CUSTOMER_ID,
    SUM(o.ORDER_TOTAL) AS lifetime_revenue
  FROM acquisition_cohorts ac
  JOIN ORDERS o ON ac.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID
  GROUP BY ac.acquisition_month, ac.CUSTOMER_ID
)
SELECT
  acquisition_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) AS num_customers,
  SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS total_lifetime_revenue
FROM customer_lifetime_revenue
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY acquisition_month

    '2026-06-17'::DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' AS prior_90_end
)
SELECT
  o.STORE_ID,
  s.STORE_NAME,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
    WHEN DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) >= (SELECT last_90_start FROM date_ranges)
    THEN o.SUBTOTAL 
  END), 0) AS revenue_last_90_days,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
    WHEN DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) >= (SELECT prior_90_start FROM date_ranges)
      AND DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) < (SELECT prior_90_end FROM date_ranges)
    THEN o.SUBTOTAL 
  END), 0) AS revenue_prior_90_days,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
      WHEN DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) >= (SELECT prior_90_start FROM date_ranges)
        AND DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) < (SELECT prior_90_end FROM date_ranges)
      THEN o.SUBTOTAL 
    END), 0) = 0
    THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(
      (COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) >= (SELECT last_90_start FROM date_ranges)
        THEN o.SUBTOTAL 
      END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) >= (SELECT prior_90_start FROM date_ranges)
          AND DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) < (SELECT prior_90_end FROM date_ranges)
        THEN o.SUBTOTAL 
      END), 0)) / COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) >= (SELECT prior_90_start FROM date_ranges)
          AND DATE(o.ORDERED_AT) < (SELECT prior_90_end FROM date_ranges)
        THEN o.SUBTOTAL 
      END), 0) * 100, 2)
  END AS growth_rate_percent
FROM ORDERS o
JOIN STORES s ON o.STORE_ID = s.STORE_ID
GROUP BY o.STORE_ID, s.STORE_NAME
ORDER BY o.STORE_ID;

        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN o.ORDERED_AT > (SELECT max_date - INTERVAL '90 days' FROM current_date_ref)
             AND o.ORDERED_AT <= (SELECT max_date FROM current_date_ref)
            THEN o.ORDER_TOTAL ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_last_90_days,
        SUM(CASE

    DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)::DATE AS month,
    SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) AS revenue
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
  WHERE OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100, 2)
  END AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month

WITH MONTHLY AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CREATED_AT) AS MONTH,
        SUM(SALE_PRICE) AS REVENUE
    FROM ORDER_ITEMS
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CREATED_AT)
)
SELECT
    MONTH,
    REVENUE,
    LAG(REVENUE) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH) AS PREV_REVENUE,
    ROUND(
        (REVENUE - LAG(REVENUE) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH))
        / NULLIF(LAG(REVENUE) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE_PCT
FROM MONTHLY
ORDER BY MONTH

WITH today AS (
  SELECT MAX(CREATED_AT) AS max_date FROM ORDER_ITEMS
),
last_90_days AS (
  SELECT 
    USER_ID,
    SUM(SALE_PRICE) AS spend_last_90
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE CREATED_AT >= (SELECT max_date FROM today) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
    AND CREATED_AT <= (SELECT max_date FROM today)
  GROUP BY USER_ID
),
prior_90_days AS (
  SELECT 
    USER_ID,
    SUM(SALE_PRICE) AS spend_prior_90
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE CREATED_AT >= (SELECT max_date FROM today) - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    AND CREATED_AT < (SELECT max_date FROM today) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.USER_ID) AS num_customers
FROM last_90_days l
LEFT JOIN prior_90_days p ON l.USER_ID = p.USER_ID
WHERE l.spend_last_90 > COALESCE(p.spend_prior_90, 0)

WITH today AS (
  SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS current_date
),
customer_spending AS (
  SELECT
    oi.USER_ID,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN oi.CREATED_AT >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' 
      THEN oi.SALE_PRICE 
      ELSE 0 
    END) AS last_90_days_spend,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN oi.CREATED_AT >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' 
        AND oi.CREATED_AT < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
      THEN oi.SALE_PRICE 
      ELSE 0 
    END) AS prior_90_days_spend
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  WHERE oi.CREATED_AT >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
  GROUP BY oi.USER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM customer_spending
WHERE last_90_days_spend > prior_90_days_spend
  AND prior_90_days_spend > 0;

WITH RANKED_DATES AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    SUM(SALE_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SPENT,
    CASE
      WHEN CREATED_AT >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 'LAST_90'
      WHEN CREATED_AT >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' THEN 'PRIOR_90'
    END AS PERIOD
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE CREATED_AT >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
    AND STATUS != 'Returned'
  GROUP BY USER_ID, PERIOD
),
PIVOTED AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN PERIOD = 'LAST_90' THEN TOTAL_SPENT ELSE 0 END) AS LAST_90_SPENT,
    MAX(CASE WHEN PERIOD = 'PRIOR_90' THEN TOTAL_SPENT ELSE 0 END) AS PRIOR_90_SPENT
  FROM RANKED_DATES
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NUM_CUSTOMERS
FROM PIVOTED
WHERE LAST_90_SPENT > PRIOR_90_SPENT
  AND PRIOR_90_SPENT > 0;

        USER_ID,
        CREATED_AT,
        LAG(CREATED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS prev_order_date
    FROM ORDERS
),
gap_days AS (
    SELECT
        USER_ID,
        DATEDIFF('day', prev_order_date, CREATED_AT) AS days_between
    FROM order_gaps
    WHERE prev_order_date IS NOT NULL
),
avg_per_customer AS (
    SELECT
        USER_ID,
        AVG(days_between) AS avg_days
    FROM gap_days
    GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(avg_days), 2) AS avg_days_between_orders
FROM avg_per_customer

WITH monthly_volume AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', O.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month,
    SUM(OP.PAYMENT_VALUE) AS total_volume
  FROM ORDERS O
  JOIN ORDER_PAYMENTS OP ON O.ORDER_ID = OP.ORDER_ID
  WHERE O.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', O.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT 
  month,
  total_volume,
  LAG(total_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_volume,
  ROUND(
    ((total_volume - LAG(total_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(total_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100,
    2
  ) AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_volume
ORDER BY month

    FROM ORDERS O

    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', O.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP)
),

    FROM MONTHLY_VOLUME
)

    CASE
        WHEN PREV_MONTH_VOLUME IS NULL OR PREV_MONTH_VOLUME = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(((TOTAL_BUSINESS_VOLUME - PREV_MONTH_VOLUME) / PREV_MONTH_VOLUME) * 100, 2)
    END AS MOM_GROWTH_RATE_PCT
FROM MONTHLY_GROWTH
ORDER BY MONTH;

      WHEN o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '180 days'
        AND o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90 days'

  GROUP BY o.CUSTOMER_ID

         COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS n_orders

  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID

WITH PAYMENT_DATES AS (
  SELECT

    OP.PAYMENT_VALUE,
    O.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP,
    CURRENT_DATE AS TODAY
  FROM ORDERS O
  JOIN ORDER_PAYMENTS OP ON O.ORDER_ID = OP.ORDER_ID
),
RECENT_90 AS (
  SELECT 
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    SUM(PAYMENT_VALUE) AS SPENDING_LAST_90
  FROM PAYMENT_DATES
  WHERE ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= TODAY - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
PRIOR_90 AS (
  SELECT 
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    SUM(PAYMENT_VALUE) AS SPENDING_PRIOR_90
  FROM PAYMENT_DATES
  WHERE ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= TODAY - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    AND ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP < TODAY - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
COMBINED AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(R.CUSTOMER_ID, P.CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_ID,
    COALESCE(R.SPENDING_LAST_90, 0) AS SPENDING_LAST_90,
    COALESCE(P.SPENDING_PRIOR_90, 0) AS SPENDING_PRIOR_90
  FROM RECENT_90 R
  FULL OUTER JOIN PRIOR_90 P ON R.CUSTOMER_ID = P.CUSTOMER_ID
)

FROM COMBINED
WHERE SPENDING_LAST_90 > SPENDING_PRIOR_90;
